#!/bin/bash
#$ -S /bin/bash
#$ -cwd
#$ -q all.q
#$ -pe mpi_32 32
#$ -N ac_@DIGEST24@
#$ -j y
#$ -o vasp.stdout
set -e
set -o pipefail
umask 077
test -n "${JOB_ID:-}" || exit 90
test "${NSLOTS:-0}" = 32 || exit 91
cd -- @ROOT@/output/calc/s01_e4
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=@ROOT@/lib
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
exec @ROOT@/bin/mpi -np "$NSLOTS" @ROOT@/bin/vasp_ncl
